title: Precept Two - Non-Stealing
speaker: Myoki Raizelah Bayen
summary: Myoki Raizelah Bayen's main teaching emphasizes the importance of embracing a mindset of non-stealing, where giving and receiving are seen as two sides of the same coin, and there is no separation between entities. This understanding allows us to let go of feelings of entitlement and scarcity, and instead cultivate an openness to what is present in the moment. By adopting this mindset, we can accept more freely what is given and give more freely, leading to a sense of liberation and satisfaction that arises from embracing the present moment without attachment or expectation.
